photo_understanding.blocker: No API endpoint connects upload → Gemini Vision → structured output. Module exists but not wired.
photo_understanding.requires: NVIDIA_API_KEY in .env, API endpoint to invoke Gemini Vision with uploaded photo

approval_gate.detail: Studio approval mechanism exists for drafts. No photo-understanding-specific approval UI.
approval_gate.can_approve: Studio drafts can be approved via commit. Photo understanding results have no dedicated approval endpoint.

geometry_generation.blocker: No API endpoint for photo→geometry. Geometry engine works with CAD/DXF input, not photo understanding output.

pascal_scene.blocker: No running Pascal MCP/REST service. Adapters convert schemas but no backend integration.

pascal_editor.blocker: Pascal MCP client is TypeScript-only. No backend bridge for live scene editing via Vision 5D API.

scene3d_generation.blocker: Requires geometry input from earlier stages. Scene3D reconstructor exists but needs real geometry data.

furniture_design.blocker: Furniture library exists. Placing furniture on 3D scenes requires studio draft workflow, not yet integrated with scene3d.

materials_lighting.blocker: No API endpoints or frontend controls for materials/lighting on 3D scenes.

camera_cinematic.blocker: No API endpoints for camera setup. Cinematic engine exists (packages/cinematic/) but not API-integrated.

video_rendering.blocker: Cinematic engine is standalone script. No API endpoint to render 3D scene to MP4. Requires 3D scene + camera config as input.

final_results_page.blocker: No dedicated results page aggregating all pipeline outputs. Individual endpoints exist.

artifact_download.detail: Artifact refs stored in DB (durable_artifact_refs table). No streaming download endpoint for local files.

verdict: VISION 5D FULL LOCAL APPLICATION PARTIALLY VERIFIED
reason: Dashboard, auth, AI config, project CRUD, and studio drafts are fully functional. Photo→understanding→geometry→Pascal→3D→video pipeline has individual components but is not wired as an end-to-end API flow.
